existingGenerationAssets.decision: Reuse VisibleGeneratedPlayablePreviewService as the in-process deterministic coordinator for ProceduralGameKernelService, FormulaEffectActionRegistryService, TinyGeneratedRuntimeLoopService and GeneratedPackageMvpService; copy their stable result strings into the project-local generation contract without external execution.
behavioralTests: same seed and options preserve plan, rule-pack, tiny-loop and MVP bytes
every supported mode produces a valid nonempty source

modernProjectBaselineConstraint.decision: Keep the existing null-base lane resolving the immutable Goal142 balanced baseline; generated projects supply a hash-validated explicit base only from project-confined staging.
behavioralTests: null base preserves historical package hashes
explicit base does not leak into the next default build

generatedOverlayContract.decision: Merge generated MVP collection records additively by stable id or sourceId; equal canonical definitions deduplicate and differing collisions fail before any project folder is committed.
behavioralTests: generated records are additive
equal collisions deduplicate
differing collisions fail causally

baselineAnchorPreservation.decision: Before project identity overlay preserve the Goal142 manifest identity and start map plus every baseline collection definition in canonical JSON; retain the generated start map as an additive map and record it in source metadata.
behavioralTests: every baseline definition is canonical-equal after overlay
baseline start map is unchanged
generated start map is present

customBaseCompositionContract.decision: Forward plan, reverse plan, metadata mutations, standard mutations, materialization, qualification and order proof consume the same descriptor path and SHA-256; custom core-only validity does not require Goal142 matrix distinctness.
behavioralTests: tampered explicit base hash is rejected
reverse order uses the explicit base
custom core-only qualifies

projectCreationTransaction.decision: Template creation remains on the original direct factory path; seeded creation materializes and validates under a sibling .creating directory and commits with one directory move only after package, identity, authoring and source validation pass.
behavioralTests: legacy template bytes and folders remain compatible
injected failure removes temporary and final folders
existing target is not mutated

generationSourceIntegrity.decision: The seeded source record contains identity-free generation inputs, actual UTF-8 sidecar byte hashes, generated counts and tiny-loop facts; missing, malformed, mismatched or unsupported records fail without baseline fallback.
behavioralTests: every required sidecar hash validates
count mismatch fails causally
source corruption preserves last success

buildAndReplayFlow.decision: Validate generated source before certification, copy its generated base into build staging, compose modules over that exact base, assert generated canonical records survive composition and identity activation, then run the existing capability-driven Runtime, checkpoint and replay qualification.
behavioralTests: all-selectable generated build and repeat pass
generated records survive composition and activation
core-only build passes without false distinctness failure

standaloneCorrelation.decision: Append generated-world facts from the same typed formatter used by WinForms to the existing standalone request; retain the accepted-mechanics and RC record flow unchanged.
behavioralTests: payload generated facts equal the typed summary
accepted-mechanics and RC facts remain complete
host reuse starts no Unity process

failureRollbackMatrix.decision: Creation failures delete the sibling temporary tree; build failures use GameProjectBuildTransaction to restore package, authoring and current-package state while generated sidecars remain read-only and the last GREEN history entry remains available.
behavioralTests: sidecar write failure leaves no project
source corruption preserves package and GREEN history
qualification failure preserves authoring

legacyProjectCompatibility.decision: Requests with no creation kind remain template; projects without seeded-project-source.json continue through the exact Goal142 baseline lane and older history entries deserialize with a null generated summary.
behavioralTests: old request creates the original package
legacy build uses the historical baseline
old history remains readable

nonGoals.decision: No Runtime, Runtime.Abstractions, public GamePackage schema, FeatureModule catalog, Unity, provider, LLM, RAG, Lua execution, media generation or generated-map activation change is required.
behavioralTests: artifact scope rejects forbidden paths
Goal142 baseline and goal148-manual remain byte-identical
Unity process start count remains zero
